cards.title: Bias-variance tradeoff through model diagnostics
cards.description: Students derive the bias-variance tradeoff and interpret diagnostic plots for a supervised learning model.
cards.why_suggested: Provides a rigorous conceptual foundation for introductory machine learning.

cards.title: Build and evaluate a campus-energy predictor
cards.description: Students build a small regression model for campus energy use and compare evaluation metrics.
cards.why_suggested: Connects model evaluation to a concrete, end-to-end project.

cards.title: Hiring-model fairness audit
cards.description: Students audit a hiring-model case, identify disparate outcomes, and recommend mitigations.
cards.why_suggested: Uses a realistic decision-making case to examine model impact.

cards.title: Clinical-risk model deployment review
cards.description: Students review a clinical-risk model case and decide whether evidence supports deployment.
cards.why_suggested: Applies machine-learning evaluation to a high-stakes deployment decision.
